Community-standard default hyperparameters: entropy_coef=0.0 in OpenRLHF (counter to pre-LLM PPO practice), adaptive-KL in OpenRLHF as safer default, T=1.0 rollouts, advantage normalization ON by default in OpenRLHF, triage order for entropy collapse.

Three-stage RLHF template; PPO-ptx equation with per-token KL inside the reward (beta=0.02); adaptive KL controller as optional knob; pretraining-mix term (gamma L_ptx).
K1/K2/K3 KL estimator comparison (Schulman blog), KL-to-reward (not loss) justification; reverse-KL (mode-seeking) semantics; adaptive-beta controller rules.
